eas_text: A civil authority has issued A MISSING AND ENDANGERED PERSON ALERT for the following counties or areas: Muskegon, MI; at 11:33 AM on AUG 3, 2026 Effective until 2:33 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: MUSKEGON COUNTY SHERIFFS OFFICE: Missing endangered 9- and 10-year-old boys. White males, dark hair, 4ft, 60lbs wearing black / gray sweatshirt with gray / black athletic pants with orange stripes. LAST SEEN NEAR MacArthur and Raven Lakes Dr in EGELESTON TWP. If seen CALL 231-724-4163.
